title: Collignon 2009 visual-deprivation lateralization - crossed posture
citation: Collignon, O., Voss, P., Lassonde, M., & Lepore, F. (2009). Early visual deprivation alters multisensory processing in peripersonal space. Neuropsychologia, 47(14), 3236-3243.
notes: Legacy local record ID is Tajadura-Jimenez 2009, but the DOI/PDF are Collignon et al. (2009). This profile recreates the crossed-posture static external left/right lateralization block: auditory-only, tactile-only, and congruent audio-tactile trials, 50 repetitions per side and modality. The anatomical stimulated hand is swapped relative to external hemispace, while responses remain coded by external left/right side. It uses procedural pink-noise bursts and mouse-click left/right choices as runnable proxies for the unshared Adobe Audition audio file and physical response keys.

reference_parameters.reported_geometry: hands palm-down 30 cm in front of the body and 25 cm left/right of body midline; speakers immediately beside the hands
reference_parameters.reported_tactile_stimulus: five 1 ms biphasic square pulses every 25 ms, 40 Hz for 100 ms, ring electrodes on middle fingers
reference_parameters.reported_trial_formula: Per posture block: 2 external sides x 3 modalities x 50 repetitions = 300 test stimuli.
reference_parameters.minimum_runnable_profile_scope: Crossed posture block only; use the uncrossed companion template for the first posture block.
nonblocking_caveats: exact pink-noise WAV or seed not supplied
ISI distribution shape not reported beyond mean and range
online response timeout not reported; the analysis window is preserved in row metadata

provenance.source: Manual PDF review: 100 ms pink-noise burst with 90 ms plateau, 5 ms ramps, simultaneous audio-tactile SOA, five 1 ms tactile pulses at 40 Hz over 100 ms.
Manual PDF review: 2 sides x 3 modalities x 50 stimuli = 300 test stimuli per posture block.
Manual PDF review and Figure 1: crossed hands swapped anatomical hand side while participants responded by external left/right side.
